name: profile-header
title: Profile header
description: The top of a person or organisation page: avatar, name, meta (role, location, status), actions, and optional tabs for the sections below.

frame.summary: Identity row (avatar + text + actions), then Tabs flush below. A section, not a Card.

regions.name: actions
regions.purpose: Follow / Message / Edit and an overflow Menu.
regions.collapse: Secondary actions move into the overflow Menu.

components.name: avatar
components.for: Photo or initials, size lg, decorative (the name is the heading).

components.name: breadcrumbs
components.for: Where this profile sits (Team › People › Ada).

headingLevel.summary: The outline level of the name (1 on a profile page); everything below it steps down from here.
use: The level the surrounding page gives this block — a template passes it explicitly.
dont: Choosing a level for its visual size. Size is the Heading component's `role`, a separate decision.
headingLevel.a11y: No default, for the reason Heading's `level` has none: only the caller knows the depth, and a skipped level breaks heading navigation for the whole page.

avatar.summary: Image URL; initials fallback comes from Avatar.

tabs.summary: Tabs items, if the page has sections.
dont: Tabs that navigate between URLs — use a nav of links; Tabs is for panels on one page.

behavior.summary: Static apart from Tabs, which owns its state.

decisions.why: Avatar's own contract: when the name is beside it, the image would announce the name twice.

decisions.decision: Tabs only when sections are panels on one page
decisions.why: If each section is its own URL it is navigation and needs links with aria-current, not role="tablist".
A banner image adds no information and has no contrast guarantee for anything over it; if wanted, it is decoration above the block.

landmarks.label: A <header> inside <main> is not a banner landmark

obligations: Action names include the person where ambiguous ("Message Ada").

steps.change: Avatar above or beside a stacked name/meta; actions below, full width; Tabs scroll horizontally.
One row: avatar, text, actions at inline end.

native.mapping: A large-title header at the top of a scrolling profile screen; actions as a toolbar or buttons under the name; tabs as a segmented control under it.
native.ios: Large title collapses into the nav bar on scroll.
